en.headline: Hong Kong Optical Fair continues with seminars and smart eyewear displays
en.dek: The three-day trade event at HKCEC features more than 600 exhibitors from 14 countries, with programmes on functional eyewear running today.
body: The 34th Hong Kong International Optical Fair continues today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council and co-organised by the Hong Kong Optical Manufacturers Association.

Under the theme Bright Eyes New Horizons, the fair has brought together more than 600 exhibitors from 14 countries and regions. Displays include AI-powered smart glasses, products for senior vision care and sustainable frames. The opening ceremony on Wednesday was officiated by Under Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Clement Woo.

Today’s programme includes a seminar on functional eyewear beyond vision correction and an exhibitor forum on technology and design. The fair runs until Friday and is open to trade visitors aged 18 or above.

zh.headline: 香港國際眼鏡展續展 智能眼鏡及功能鏡片成焦點
zh.dek: 為期三日的商貿展在會展舉行，逾600間來自14個國家及地區的參展商參與，今日有功能眼鏡研討環節。
body: 第34屆香港國際眼鏡展今日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心繼續舉行，由香港貿易發展局主辦，香港中華眼鏡製造廠商會合辦。
展覽以「睛彩新視野」為主題，雲集超過600家來自14個國家及地區的展商，展示人工智能智能眼鏡、銀髮視力護理產品及可持續鏡框。周三開幕禮由政制及內地事務局副局長胡健民主持。
今日活動包括功能眼鏡超越視力矯正的研討會，以及科技與設計的展商論壇。展覽至周五結束，只供18歲或以上的業內人士參觀。
